card.name: Casual interjections in informal prose
card.fires_on: Chatty, informal asides in web text, such as Yeah, Why not, Whoa, Yep and By the way. Also fires on words inside casual phrases like on the other hand.

modes.label: Exclamations
modes.description: Short spoken-style interjections that open a casual remark.
modes.example: mount -t cd9660 /dev/vnd0a /mnt <<Yeah>>, image contents appear under Go to

modes.label: Conversational phrases
modes.description: Words inside stock aside phrases like by the way or on the other hand.
modes.example: a target to chase when they got their turns at the controls. By the<< way>>, this was just about the first time

modes.label: Parenthetical asides
modes.description: Words inside a bracketed or wry remark to the reader.
modes.example: (although you probably would not volunteer to<< try>>)

card.writes: It promotes informal, colloquial adjectives like funky, nasty and creepy, which suggests it pushes toward a casual, chatty tone.
card.plain: It marks a casual, chatty aside where the writer talks directly to the reader.
